semanticPurpose: D1 네기마 조립의 큼직한 대파 토막 한 조각이다. 런타임은 MDL-SKEWER-BASE의 slot anchor에 skewerSocket을 결합해 닭→파→닭→파→닭 순서를 구성한다.

sourceReferences.role: user-approved D1 assembly full-screen source; direct visual reference for chunky negi segment, layered cut end, green palette, and pixel contour

generation.tool: deterministic Three.js GLTFExporter with reused approved imagegen texture source
generation.textureMode: R2-approved raw Japanese green-onion material reused unchanged; only assembly-pose plane rotation is corrected
generation.promptSummary: exactly one large thick Japanese negi segment with ribbed dark green exterior and one pale layered cut end; no chicken, skewer, scene, UI, or shadow; uniform #ff00ff chroma-key background
postProcess: R2 source alpha and nearest 256×192 pixel albedo are reused unchanged
R2 actual jig integration found the 64° decal correction doubled under the base parent Z=-90° rotation
R3 changes only the pixel-material-plane rotation to -26° so its long silhouette is screen-vertical in the real horizontal-skewer assembly pose
body long axis remains local X; skewerSocket local +Y crosses the body laterally
actual R3 GLB plus albedo rendered alone on neutral checkerboard in the same assembly pose

inspection.bodyLongAxis: local X; perpendicular to skewer axis
inspection.assemblyPose: base parent Z=-90° makes the long axis screen-vertical

validation.glbParse: root origin [0,0,0]; skewerSocket and pixel-material-plane present; 42 triangles

contains: one MDL-INGREDIENT-NEGI GLB with its pixel albedo in actual base assembly pose

excludes: chicken, bamboo skewer, cooked green onion, a second negi piece, jig, transfer tray, ingredient bin, background scene, character, UI, text, quantity, checkmark, shadow, or VFX
state-specific raster frames or a baked completed skewer
approvalQuestion: R3 대파 토막 모델 bundle 한 개만 검토한다. 이 검수판은 실제 수평 꼬치 부모와 같은 Z=-90° assembly pose를 적용했다. 대파가 화면상 수직이고, 런타임의 수평 꼬치(local +Y)가 옆면 중심을 관통하는지, 승인 D1 원본의 굵은 초록 원통·층상 절단면·픽셀 윤곽과 어울리는지, 투명 경계가 깨끗한지 확인한다. 꼬치·닭·jig는 포함하지 않는다.
nextGate: 승인 후 빈 꼬치·닭·R3 대파의 결합 동작을 실제 D1 조립 jig에서 한 화면으로 검수한다.
